findingDetails.title: Three adapters still create a directory tree at a payload-named path, and one of them then deletes a file there
findingDetails.scopeProof: completion-evidence-post-agent.cjs:110, turn-start.mjs:52, ask-capture-post-tool.mjs:41-45 and ask-surface-post-agent.mjs:105 are the complete set of Vibe adapters that derive a filesystem root from payload.cwd; compaction-context.mjs:76-88 is the only one that guards it
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a shared helper that rejects a non-absolute or non-existent payload.cwd before any adapter uses it

findingDetails.title: compaction-post-tool fires on every tool call and its compaction half consults no kill switch, while the hand-over half in the same process does
findingDetails.scopeProof: compaction-post-tool.mjs is the only bound script with neither an isHookEnabled nor an isGuardEnabled call in itself or in its delegate chain; the census covers all 18 bindings plus the four unbound adapters
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: an isHookEnabled call inside buildPostToolPart or in compaction-post-tool.mjs before the detector runs

findingDetails.title: The home renderer's leftover-substitution check inspects only command = lines, so a multi-line TOML string hides a substitution on a continuation line
findingDetails.scopeProof: :94-99 is the only leftover-substitution check in the file, and :103 is the only write of the rendered text
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a hooks.toml that uses only single-line command strings, which is the current file

results.summary: The binding census matches the reference: 18 bindings, 2 pre_agent, 7 strict pre_tool, 6 post_tool, 1 post_agent, 1 session_start, 1 session_end. The reference wrongly calls all six post_tool entries non-strict while hooks.toml:93 declares post-edit-quality strict; the document is wrong, not the binding, and the mismatch is carried into the traceability pass.
The declared target is a file set, not a spec folder with a checklist; the disposition table is an exclusion list, not a checklist to verify.

noveltyJustification: weightedNew = 3 (three P2) against weightedTotal 13, the accumulated active set after this iteration (1 P1 = 5, 8 P2 = 8). No prior finding was refined or repeated: the three findings are a new class instance, a new control-plane gap and a new refusal-coverage gap, none of them a restatement of iteration 1's payload-seam findings.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 27 hook and plugin files across two runtimes, with a security-relevant fail-open seam, a documented wire format and a dispositioned prior review to check against

targetSelection.selectionReason: the security dimension's trust boundaries: the payload-derived state roots, the kill-switch census, the home renderer's path refusals, and the env-secret-guard coverage the previous iteration deferred to this pass

searchLedger.hypothesis: an adapter creates or deletes a file at a path the payload names, with no absolute or existing-directory guard

searchActions.result: mkdirSync recursive plus writeFileSync on join(payload.cwd, fixed relative path), and unlinkSync on the same path, with no guard
the guarded sibling: stateDirFor requires isAbsolute and statSync().isDirectory(), and the comment states the rule

searchLedger.rationale: confirmed by direct read; the class is already dispositioned as Fixed for the compaction detector, so this is a still-open instance

searchLedger.hypothesis: a bound hook consults no kill switch, so an operator disable does not take effect

searchActions.queryOrPath: isHookEnabled over all 18 bound scripts plus the four unbound adapters
searchActions.result: sixteen gate themselves or delegate to a gated module, env-secret-guard uses isGuardEnabled, git-message-gate documents the absence at :9, compaction-post-tool has zero hits and no documented reason

searchLedger.rationale: the same process gates its hand-over half and not its compaction half, which is the counterexample that makes the gap a defect rather than a convention

searchLedger.hypothesis: the leftover-substitution refusal misses a form the file could take

searchActions.result: the check filters to lines matching /^\s*command\s*=/ before testing LEFTOVER_SUBSTITUTION, so a multi-line basic string's continuation lines are never inspected

searchLedger.rationale: the check is complete for the current single-line file, so the finding is about coverage rather than a live substitution

searchLedger.hypothesis: the binding matches a tool the core does not judge

searchActions.result: FILE_TOOLS covers read_file/write/edit, SHELL_TOOLS covers bash, and evaluateToolCall dispatches on shell commands, wrapped code-mode commands and file paths

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the binding and the core agree on every tool name

searchLedger.hypothesis: the advisory text carries model output back into the next turn's context

searchActions.result: the advisory detail is built from fixed strings plus specFolder; markTurn defaults baseDir to tmpdir(); headReceiptDir resolves from tmpdir() or a configured environment path

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no path carries model text into the advisory, and neither the marker nor the receipt directory is payload-rooted
